title: NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 spec sheet
supports: Each GB300 NVL72 compute tray (4 GPUs) has 8x E1.S Gen5 NVMe bays plus 1x M.2 boot; Gigabyte DLB2-CB3 datasheet agrees; HPE QuickSpecs list 4 or 8 populated, E1.S capacities 3.84/7.68/15 TB (via search snippet; red-team rt-CIRC, query 1)

title: Gigabyte DLB2-CB3 GB300 compute tray datasheet
supports: 8 E1.S bays per compute tray (via search snippet; rt-CIRC query 1)

title: HPE GB300 NVL72 QuickSpecs
supports: Front E1.S data drives 4x or 8x per tray; 3.84/7.68/15 TB (via search snippet; rt-CIRC query 1)

title: Chen et al., temperature dependence of a-IGZO TFTs, IEEE TED 2009
supports: a-IGZO TFT threshold voltage falls linearly with temperature at about -17 mV/K (3 V to 2 V over the range); SS and on/off roughly constant (via search snippet; rt-CIRC query 2). Long-channel display TFT, may not transfer to 40 nm ALD devices.

title: IGZO-based capacitorless 2T0C DRAM operation at 77 K
supports: IGZO 2T0C subthreshold swing 161 mV/dec at 300 K (99 mV/dec at 77 K); retention 5x longer at 77 K (via search snippet; rt-CIRC query 2)
